title: Senior Product Specialist
jobDescription:
Job Purpose
We are looking for a Senior UI Developer to build a modern, conversational user interface for an enterprise AI platform. This role focuses on creating a clean, minimal, and highly interactive single-page experience where users interact primarily through conversation rather than traditional screens. You will work closely with backend, AI, and SDK teams to translate system responses into intuitive, dynamic UI components. The role involves building complex animations, handling multimodal inputs, ensuring performance inside mobile WebViews, and maintaining high code quality suitable for large-scale production systems.
Duties and Responsibilities
Conversational UI Frontend Development Design and build a single-page, conversational UI that replaces traditional multi-screen flows. Develop dynamic, schema-driven UI components that render based on user intent, profile, and system capabilities. Implement fluid animations, transitions, and motion systems while ensuring performance inside mobile WebViews and browsers. Build support for multimodal inputs and outputs including text, voice, image, and file interactions. Ensure UI adapts gracefully across devices, channels (WebView vs browser), and capability constraints. UI Architecture Code Quality Contribute to frontend architecture decisions, component design, and state management patterns. Build reusable, well-structured UI components with clear separation of concerns. Ensure code is clean, maintainable, and easy for other developers to understand and extend. Work closely with backend teams to consume UI schemas, capability flags, and conversational state. Performance, Security Stability Optimize bundle size, rendering performance, and animation smoothness for low-end devices. Implement fallback and degradation strategies for constrained environments. Follow secure frontend practices including CSP compliance, PII masking, and safe handling of user inputs. Support analytics, audit events, and session tracking hooks as required by enterprise standards. Collaboration Delivery Collaborate with AI, backend, SDK, and product teams to translate conversational responses into effective UI. Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and iterative UI improvements. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines for frontend builds and deployments
Key Decisions / Dimensions
UI Design Implementation Decisions Choosing appropriate UI patterns for conversational and single-task interfaces instead of traditional page-based navigation. Deciding when UI behavior should be driven by backend schemas versus handled locally in the frontend. Selecting animation and motion techniques that balance visual richness with performance constraints. Deciding fallback and degradation strategies for low-end devices, WebView limitations, and browser constraints. Framework Component Decisions Defining reusable UI components and interaction patterns to be used across journeys. Choosing libraries or native implementations for animations, gestures, and multimodal interactions. Deciding how to structure components to keep them extensible and easy to maintain. Ensuring configuration-driven UI is preferred over hardcoded logic wherever possible. Performance, Security Stability Decisions Deciding trade-offs between UI complexity and runtime performance. Implementing safe handling and rendering of user inputs, media, and AI responses. Deciding what data is rendered, masked, or excluded in the UI for compliance and audit needs. Testing UI changes across devices, OS versions, and integration environments before release
Major Challenges
Building a highly dynamic, conversational UI that replaces traditional screen-based navigation without confusing users. Delivering fluid, futuristic animations and rich visual effects while maintaining performance inside mobile WebViews and low-end devices. Handling multimodal inputs and outputs reliably across different devices, browsers, and mobile OS versions. Working within strict security, privacy, and compliance constraints while implementing advanced UI interactions. Adapting UI behavior based on user capabilities, channel limitations, and backend-driven schemas. Debugging and optimizing UI issues that span frontend code, WebView behavior, SDK integration, and backend responses. Maintaining clean, scalable frontend architecture as UI logic becomes increasingly dynamic and personalized.
Required Qualifications and Experience
Educational Qualifications Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 34 years of hands-on frontend development experience. Technical Skills Strong proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Experience with modern frontend frameworks (Svelte, React, or equivalent). Experience building dynamic, single-page, component-based applications. Hands-on experience with animations, transitions, and motion systems. Experience handling multimodal inputs (text, voice, image, file). Familiarity with WebView constraints and cross-browser compatibility. Experience integrating with backend APIs (REST/gRPC). Performance, Security Quality Knowledge of frontend performance optimization and bundle management. Awareness of frontend security practices and safe input handling. Experience integrating analytics, audit events, and logging. Exposure to CI/CD pipelines for frontend builds.

title: Sr Product Manager - Flights OTA
jobDescription:
Own a Flights problem space end-to-end - not a screen, not a funnel stage. Youll take the traveller journey across shopping, booking, and post-booking and be accountable for how it performs commercially and how it behaves when reality intervenes: fares that move, tickets that fail, schedules that change, and travellers who need to cancel.
The scope deliberately spans surfaces. Metasearch and comparison remain central to how travellers find us, but the interesting problems now sit in the seams - where a supplier switch at booking time creates a support contact three days later, where a baggage allowance we didnt parse at search time becomes a refund dispute, where the fare rule we couldnt read at purchase becomes a $700 agency debit memo six months on.
This is an individual contributor role with real leverage. Youll lead cross-functional squads across Engineering, Design, Data Science, Supply, Commercial, Finance Ops, and Customer Support, and youll be measured on outcomes - conversion, traffic quality, provider performance, cost-to-serve, retention - not on shipping velocity.
What youll actually work on
These are live, funded programmes, not aspirations. The detail will shift the shape wont. Here are some examples of problems you ll need to solve.
Zero Touch - self-service refunds and exchanges. Most of our contact-centre volume is travellers asking whether they can cancel or change, and most of them dont proceed once they see the cost. Youll make that answer instant, accurate, and self-serve - genuinely end to end, including back-office execution and finance reconciliation. A refund that looks automated to the traveller but spawns four manual touches behind the scenes hasnt been automated, its been moved. Youll also design the hybrid cases, with a human in the loop.
A booking record that reflects reality. Youll help define a store that traces a trip across its full lifecycle with every money movement attached, and that reconciles sources when they disagree - which they do, sometimes on the same booking, in ways that cost us real money.
Untangling the money. Payment fees, markups, booking fees, supplier costs, penalties, and the residue of every reprice, currently spread across a dozen-plus spreadsheets and recurring arguments about which one is right. Youll work with Finance Ops on the mid-office layer that puts it all on one record - including the honest build-versus-buy call.
The hard part: what makes automation here different
Read this as a preview of your first quarter, not as a warning.
  • 90% accurate is not a pass. In most products a heuristic thats right nine times out of ten is a win. Here, the 10% is a traveller told their ticket was refundable when it wasnt - so we either break a promise or eat the loss - or a void we shouldnt have processed, which returns as an airline debit six months later with a penalty attached. Youll have to reason about failure cost per decision, not aggregate accuracy.
  • The truth is spread across systems that dont agree. There is no single row you can trust. Much of this work is deciding what the source of truth is before you can automate anything on top of it.
  • Money moves before the answer is known. Funds have often already gone to the supplier by the time we decide what the traveller is owed. Product decisions here land directly on finance reconciliation, and youll need to design with that in mind rather than hand it over.
  • Complexity were choosing to keep. Continuous reprice optimization is a significant profit stream. We are not turning it off to make servicing simpler. Youll be automating on top of a system that deliberately mutates bookings after sale.
  • Some rules only exist in someones head. A real part of this role is operational design: turning tacit knowledge held by a handful of people into something a system - or an AI agent - can act on.
Key responsibilities
  • Strategy and vision. Define and evolve the strategy for your Flights problem space, aligned to marketplace growth and commercial objectives. Identify where we can be structurally more competitive, and translate that into measurable outcomes.
  • Roadmap and delivery. Own the roadmap and its sequencing, prioritising on customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, and dependency risk. Lead initiatives through discovery, validation, delivery, experimentation, launch, and optimisation. Balance near-term commercial wins against foundational platform investment - and be able to defend the trade-off.
  • Experience quality. Champion a fast, intuitive, and above all truthful experience at every stage. Optimise relevance, price presentation, filtering, comparison, provider selection, fulfilment, and self-service. Validate with research, experimentation, and behavioural data.
  • Data and performance. Partner with Data Science and Analytics on funnel health. Define and track KPIs across acquisition, engagement, conversion, retention, traffic quality, provider performance, cost-to-serve, and marketplace efficiency.
  • Cross-functional leadership. Work across Engineering, Design, Supply, Commercial, Marketing, Revenue Management, Finance Ops, and Customer Support. Communicate priorities, decisions, and trade-offs clearly. Build alignment without direct authority.
  • Market intelligence. Track airline distribution shifts, NDC adoption, competitor moves, and emerging technology - particularly AI applied to fare interpretation and servicing - and turn that into initiatives.
  • Risk and operational excellence. Surface delivery, technical, commercial, and regulatory risk early. Improve experimentation frameworks and development process. Keep decisions consistent with platform stability and long-term maintainability.
Who you are Required - non-negotiable
  • 5+ years in Product Management, with direct ownership of customer-facing digital products.
  • Meaningful experience as a PM in a Flights OTA - a business that sells and services flight tickets. Metasearch, aggregation, comparison, or affiliate-only experience does not substitute for this.
  • Depth across more than one flights problem space. For example shopping and booking booking and post-booking supply and shopping. We want someone who has seen how decisions in one stage surface as cost or breakage in another.
  • Working fluency in flight distribution mechanics. You should be comfortable, unprompted, with: PNRs versus tickets and why they diverge fare rules, fare families and FBC logic refunds versus exchanges, voluntary versus involuntary EDIFACT and NDC behaviour across GDSs LCC direct-connect realities ancillaries and baggage agency debit memos and settlement.
  • Experience where product decisions touched money movement - pricing, fees, markups, refunds, chargebacks, or supplier reconciliation. Youve had to explain your product decision to a finance team.
  • Comfort with ambiguity in the data itself. Youve shipped in environments where the systems disagreed and part of the job was deciding what to believe.
  • Strong experimentation and analytics practice - you form hypotheses, size them, and change your mind on evidence.
  • Demonstrated influence without authority across engineering, design, analytics, commercial, and operations.
  • Clear, direct communication with technical and non-technical audiences, and the confidence to disagree upward with evidence.
Preferred
  • Post-booking or servicing ownership: refunds, exchanges, schedule change, disruption, self-service.
  • Experience automating operational workflows and measuring cost-to-serve, not just conversion.
  • Exposure to mid-office, back-office, or reconciliation systems.
  • Experience applying LLMs or AI agents to unstructured domain data in production - with a realistic view of where they break.
  • MENA market exposure, or experience in a comparably fragmented multi-market environment.
This is probably not the role for you if
  • Your flights experience is metasearch or affiliate distribution only.
  • Youve owned a funnel stage but never the consequences of it downstream.
  • Youd rather define the strategy than sit with Finance Ops working out why a supplier statement doesnt reconcile.
  • You need the problem to be well-defined before youll engage with it. Much of this isnt yet.

Mission
Roche has established the Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics- and technology-driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe. GATE enables data-led decision-making and innovation across healthcare and biotech operations

You will work closely with the U.S. Strategic Customer Support Consulting team dedicated to Roches most important diagnostic customers - large reference laboratories, hospital networks, and integrated health systems. The teams mandate is to help these customers run more resilient, efficient, and cost-effective supply chain operations.

Your Opportunity
As the Senior Data Scientist in this team, you will own the forecasting, optimization, and machine learning work that underpins our customer engagements. You will inherit and evolve an existing production forecasting engine, harden it for scale across accounts, and extend it into a broader supply chain optimization framework. You will also provide recommendations and strategic support on other various customer supply chain initiatives, related to forecasting, optimization and machine learning.

This is a hybrid technical-consultative role. Roughly half your impact will come from the depth and rigor of the models you build; the other half will come from your ability to sit across the table from a senior customer stakeholder, understand their operational reality, and convert a model output into a decision they act on.

Experience in Gen AI, LLM, NLP, and ML Ops will be considered an added advantage, supporting Roches future-ready analytics and AI roadmap.

How Youll Work
You will be part of a wider data and analytics community at Roche, and your best work will happen in partnership with it. You will collaborate closely with our product and visualization teams to make sure the models you build reach business and customer teams as clear, usable views - translating forecasts, inventory recommendations, and risk signals into the reports and interfaces people actually work from. You must operate well with ambiguity and changing priorities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Work internally with other technology teams to ensure solutions built can be used throughout the transition to ASPIRE and other similar system changes (ie Agility/ARID migration to Snowflake, Google to Microsoft)
  • Drive and support industry-leading initiatives such as a Digital Twin Risk Analysis for scenario planning and modeling, Inventory Rightsizing and Safety Stock Analysis tools, Freight and Network Optimization modeling, and Carbon Footprint tracking and reduction
  • Collaborate on Agentic AI capabilities on top of existing and future databases and tools
  • Build reusable models, methodologies, and accelerators that the consulting team can deploy repeatedly across accounts, rather than rebuilding bespoke solutions each time
  • Present modelling results, business cases, and quantified impact (service level, working capital, wastage reduction) to senior internal and external audiences through clear, persuasive storytelling
  • Capture learning from each engagement and feed it back into the teams models, methods, and scalable offerings

You are a hands-on technical builder with 6+ years of experience in hands-on data science, with demonstrable specialization in forecasting. You possess strong analytical problem-solving skills and thrive in a technical-consultative role, turning complex operational processes into automated, production-ready models.

  • Hands-on experience building models using algorithms and techniques such as multivariate regression, time series analysis, XGBoost, clustering, classification, OLS regression, and causal inference methods
  • Proven experience in inventory optimization, replenishment policy design, and/or supply chain network modelling, with a track record of delivering measurable service-level or working-capital impact

Prior consulting, client-facing data science, or customer success experience is strongly preferred
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills - you can move fluently between a model diagnostic conversation with an engineer and a value conversation with a customer executive
  • Comfortable building trust and running effective customer engagements remotely - virtual workshops, video-based executive presentations, and asynchronous collaboration across time zones
  • Good working knowledge of reporting and visualization practice - you understand how dashboards are designed and consumed, and can partner effectively with visualization teams to specify what business and customer audiences need to see. Familiarity with tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik is an advantage
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, with experience using libraries and frameworks such as scikit-learn, statsmodels, PyTorch/TensorFlow, pandas, NumPy, Spark, and forecasting-specific tooling (eg, Prophet, statsforecast/Nixtla, GluonTS, Darts)

Job Summary

We are seeking an accomplished Project lead to lead the delivery of high-rise greenfield construction projects/Residential projects from inception through completion. This senior leadership role requires extensive experience managing complex vertical construction while coordinating multiple disciplines, ensuring safety excellence, maintaining quality standards, and delivering projects on schedule and within budget.

Core Responsibilities

  • Project Leadership & Execution: Lead overall construction management for high-rise greenfield projects encompassing site establishment, foundation works, superstructure construction, fa ade installation, MEP systems integration, and interior fit-out through to handover. Develop and implement comprehensive construction execution strategies aligned with project objectives and client requirements. Establish project governance frameworks including organizational structures, reporting protocols, and decision-making hierarchies. Direct project mobilization activities including site setup, temporary facilities, logistics planning, and resource deployment. Manage critical interfaces between construction phases and coordinate sequencing across multiple work fronts to optimize productivity and schedule performance.
  • Team Management & Leadership: Build and lead high-performing project teams including construction managers, engineers, coordinators, and site supervision staff. Provide clear direction, mentorship, and professional development opportunities to team members. Conduct regular performance reviews and implement capability development programs. Foster collaborative team culture focused on safety, quality, and delivery excellence. Interface with senior client representatives, consultants, contractors, and regulatory authorities at executive level. Chair senior project meetings including monthly progress reviews, risk workshops, and stakeholder coordination sessions.
  • Planning, Scheduling & Progress Management: Oversee master project scheduling and coordinate detailed construction sequencing across all trades and disciplines. Monitor critical path activities and implement recovery strategies when delays threaten milestone achievements. Direct look-ahead planning processes ensuring material procurement, workforce availability, and equipment resources align with construction requirements. Manage progress measurement systems and verify completed work against payment schedules. Coordinate tower crane operations, hoist schedules, and vertical material logistics specific to high-rise construction. Implement advanced construction methodologies including prefabrication strategies, off-site manufacturing integration, and vertical transportation optimization.
  • Contract & Commercial Management: Administer head contracts and manage relationships with principal contractors and major subcontractors. Oversee variation management processes including assessment, pricing negotiation, and approval workflows. Direct claims management and dispute resolution activities, escalating to senior management when required. Monitor commercial performance including cost forecasting, cash flow management, and budget tracking. Review and approve subcontractor payment certificates ensuring accuracy and contractual compliance. Manage extension of time claims and assess contractor entitlements under contract provisions.
  • Quality & Compliance Assurance: Ensure construction quality meets design specifications, building codes, and client requirements throughout all phases. Implement inspection and testing protocols specific to high-rise construction including concrete strength verification, structural steel connections, fa ade performance testing, and MEP systems commissioning. Review and approve method statements, risk assessments, and construction methodologies for high-risk activities including working at height, heavy lifting operations, and fa ade installation. Coordinate regulatory inspections and building authority approvals at key construction stages. Oversee defects management through punch list compilation, rectification tracking, and practical completion certification.
  • Safety, Health & Environment Leadership: Champion safety culture and ensure zero-harm principles are embedded across project operations. Enforce strict compliance with safety regulations, company policies, and industry best practices for high-rise construction. Conduct regular site safety inspections and participate in incident investigations with implementation of corrective actions. Oversee high-risk work activities including tower crane operations, edge protection systems, scaffolding, fall prevention measures, and confined space work. Monitor environmental compliance including dust suppression, noise management, waste disposal, and erosion control. Lead emergency response planning and ensure site preparedness for potential incidents.
  • Risk & Issue Management: Identify, assess, and manage project risks across technical, commercial, schedule, safety, and stakeholder dimensions. Develop risk mitigation strategies and contingency plans for high-impact scenarios. Monitor risk registers and implement proactive measures to minimize risk realization. Resolve complex technical and coordination challenges through systematic problem-solving and collaboration with design teams. Manage unforeseen conditions, design changes, and scope variations with minimal impact to project objectives.
  • Stakeholder & Client Relations: Serve as primary construction interface with client representatives and senior stakeholders. Prepare and present comprehensive progress reports, financial summaries, and risk assessments for client review meetings. Manage client expectations regarding schedule performance, budget status, and quality deliverables. Coordinate public relations activities and manage community engagement for projects in sensitive urban environments. Facilitate coordination with adjacent property owners, local authorities, and utility providers affected by construction activities.

Essential Experience

  • Minimum 12 to 15 years of progressive construction management experience with at least 8 years focused on high-rise buildings (15+ floors). Demonstrated track record managing greenfield projects from ground-breaking through completion and handover. Proven success delivering multiple high-rise projects on time and within budget. Experience with various contractual delivery methods including Design-Build, Construction Management, and Traditional Lump Sum contracts.

Technical Expertise

Knowledge of MEP systems integration in high-rise buildings including electrical distribution, HVAC systems, plumbing and drainage, fire protection and life safety systems, and building automation systems. Familiarity with advanced construction technologies including BIM coordination and 4D scheduling, prefabrication and modular construction, crane and hoist logistics optimization, and construction management software platforms.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries - moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.

The Regional Sales Enablement Partner - APAC (RSEP) is a sales practitioner and enablement leader responsible for the readiness, coaching, and performance of Genesys APAC field and partner sales organization. Bringing firsthand sales experience to the role, the RSEP builds trusted relationships with regional sales leaders and cross-functional partners to diagnose performance gaps, then designs and facilitates the coaching, training, and readiness programs that close them.

The RSEP is as comfortable in a live coaching conversation with a seller or manager as they are advising senior leadership on regional go-to-market priorities. They apply sales methodology expertise, data, and AI-enabled tools to sharpen judgment and scale impact - and they show up in the field, role-playing, shadowing calls, reviewing deals, and reinforcing skills in the flow of work. Ultimately, the RSEP is a trusted advisor and an adjunct member of the regional sales leadership team, measured on tangible improvements in seller performance and pipeline outcomes.

The RSEP is part of a global enablement team: some programs are built centrally at the global level, and the RSEP is responsible for tailoring and localizing them for APACs markets, languages, and selling motions, while also feeding regional field insight back into how those global programs are designed. The RSEP is expected to operate fluently in both directions - shaping what gets built globally and making sure it lands regionally.

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience working with Sales team (technology/SaaS strongly preferred), plus 5+ years in sales enablement, coaching, or sales performance roles, including experience leading enablement for a region or business unit; bachelors degree or equivalent experience.
  • Proven track record coaching and developing sellers and front-line sales managers - through call/deal reviews, live shadowing, and structured 1:1 coaching - with measurable improvement in skills and results.
  • Strong facilitation skills, with confidence leading in-person and virtual sessions for sellers, managers, and partners across diverse APAC audiences, languages, and time zones.
  • Deep fluency in enterprise sales methodology (eg, MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, Value Selling, or similar), with the ability to embed it into everyday selling behavior rather than simply introduce it.
  • Demonstrated credibility as a trusted advisor to sales leadership and cross-functional partners (Marketing, RevOps, Product, Partner/Channel), with the executive presence and influence-without-authority to shape decisions at senior levels.
  • Data-driven approach - comfortable analyzing pipeline, conversion, and performance data (CRM, Clari, conversation-intelligence tools) to diagnose gaps and demonstrate enablement impact.
  • Experience in a cloud/SaaS company, ideally supporting complex, multi-persona sales motions across direct and partner/channel teams.
  • Experience operating as part of a global, matrixed enablement team - tailoring centrally-built global programs for regional nuance while feeding field insight back into global program design.
  • Comfort leveraging AI-enabled tools to support coaching preparation, content development, and performance analysis, with a growth mindset toward new AI-supported approaches to enablement.
  • Proficiency with the sales and enablement tech stack (CRM, Seismic, LMS/Lessonly or similar) and standard business tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Self-motivated, organized, and effective at managing multiple priorities in a fast-changing, matrixed environment.
  • Fluency in languages outside of English a plus, particularly APAC regional languages.

Key Responsibilities

The Regional Sales Enablement Partner spends the majority of their time directly engaged with sellers, managers, and leaders in the field - coaching, facilitating, and diagnosing performance gaps - while also shaping the regional enablement strategy that those activities feed into. Success in this role is measured by improvement in seller skill, pipeline quality, and win rate.

Sales Coaching & Skill Development

  • Deliver 1:1 and team-level coaching to sellers and front-line sales managers to reinforce methodology and close specific skill gaps.
  • Facilitate engaging, high-impact enablement sessions - in person and virtual - including role-play, negotiation practice, discovery and objection-handling drills, and certification workshops.
  • Support new hire ramp to accelerate time-to-productivity and build early confidence.
  • Design and deliver skills-based training aligned to the moments that matter most in a sellers day-to-day motion.

Strategic Advisory & Stakeholder Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to APAC sales leadership and cross-functional partners (Marketing, RevOps, Product, Partner/Channel), proactively surfacing performance gaps and enablement opportunities grounded in data and field insight.
  • Build strong relationships with regional stakeholders to pinpoint knowledge and skills gaps, validating findings with data before recommending action.
  • Bring firsthand field credibility into planning conversations, informing GTM and enablement priorities with real signal from coaching conversations, deal reviews, and seller feedback.
  • Represent APACs needs and constraints to the global enablement team, providing field-tested input that shapes how global programs are designed and where regional tailoring will be needed.
  • Partner with global enablement peers and instructional designers to localize and adapt global programs for APACs sellers, partners, and languages.

Global Program Contribution & Regional Readiness

  • Tailor and localize globally-built enablement programs - content, methodology, and delivery format - for APACs markets, languages, buyer dynamics, and selling motions, ensuring global programs actually change seller behavior in region.
  • Own the quarterly readiness plan that brings global programs to APAC field and partner sales, translating global priorities and regional performance data into a prioritized, localized coaching and training calendar.
  • Feed regional field insight - from coaching conversations, deal reviews, and seller feedback - back into the global team to inform how future global programs are designed and where global consistency vs. regional flexibility is needed.
  • Apply AI-enabled tools to accelerate content localization, personalize coaching plans, and synthesize field feedback at scale.
  • Maintain a consistent through-line between global enablement strategy and regional execution - flagging where global programs need adaptation and closing that loop with the global team.

Performance Insights & Optimization

  • Partner with Sales Ops/RevOps to track how coaching and enablement activity moves pipeline creation, conversion rates, and seller productivity.

title: Product Owner III
jobDescription:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the worlds leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.
By Connecting Convenience across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy. We re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.
Role Overview:
PDI Technologies is looking for a Product Owner to help drive our mobile product roadmap from vision to delivery. This individual will take roadmap initiatives and solution briefs and break them down into clear, well-structured PRDs that our engineering teams can pick up and execute against - keeping delivery moving in a fast-paced, iterative environment.
This role sits within our broader Mobile Platform and Framework effort - the underlying solution that lets customers bring a highly customizable, flexible branded app to market - with expected primary focus on Mobile Engagement Manager (MEM), a web-based portal being built on top of the Mobile Platform that will let end customers modify, update, and change elements of their own mobile app themselves, backed by a full publishing engine. MEM is early in its build, so this is a chance to help shape a new product from the ground up alongside engineering and design. Exact scope of ownership across the Mobile Platform and MEM will be finalized as the team ramps up, and there is flexibility for this to evolve.
As a Product Owner, you are a critical member of an Agile development team, translating product strategy into high-quality, high-value features. Youll work closely with Agile engineering teams, Product Managers, customers, and business stakeholders to shape requirements for our consumer-facing mobile experiences. Prior experience in Product Management, Product Owner, or Business Analyst roles for a consumer-focused mobile app or platform/framework product is highly desired.
This role is expected to use AI tools and processes as a core part of how work gets done - accelerating requirements-gathering, documentation, and story breakdown so the team can move faster without sacrificing quality.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Stay aligned with and contribute to the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for Mobile Engagement Manager (MEM), with visibility into the broader Mobile Platform/Framework
  • Translate roadmap initiatives and solution briefs into detailed, engineering-ready PRDs and user stories
  • Help define and evolve requirements for MEMs publishing engine - how customers configure, preview, and push changes to their live mobile app
  • As needed, extend into Mobile Platform-level decisions (what should be configurable, extensible, or standardized across customers) as they intersect with MEM
  • Work closely with Support to understand and prioritize customer-reported issues affecting the mobile app and platform experience
  • Work closely with system users (customers, partners, consulting) to understand product needs and translate them into actionable user stories
  • Apply technical astuteness, attention to detail, and proactivity to drive closure and optimize development team throughput
  • Use AI-assisted tools and workflows to speed up requirements analysis, documentation, and backlog preparation
  • Serve as a product evangelist, particularly with Product Managers and Business teams, helping them understand platform best practices
  • Develop documentation for new mobile and MEM features, including UI mockups, process flows, and data sequence diagrams
  • Attend sprint planning meetings and work with the team to define sprint goals
  • Guide Agile teams in breaking down user stories and defining acceptance criteria
  • Ensure the product backlog is prioritized and properly balanced between new product work and maintenance
  • Collaborate with engineering during sprints to review output and answer questions about desired functionality and outcomes
  • Ensure the team has an appropriately groomed backlog ready for sprint planning; monitor ready stories vs. velocity
  • Conduct backlog refinement meetings, sprint reviews, and product demos
  • Manage the product backlog in ALM tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
  • Author and publish product release notes and customer notifications
  • Own release planning for Mobile Platform and MEM initiatives
Qualifications:
  • Prior experience with consumer-facing mobile apps (iOS/Android) - writing requirements, PRDs, or user stories for a mobile product strongly preferred
  • Experience with platform, framework, or configurable/multi-tenant products is a strong plus, given the customizable nature of the Mobile Platform
  • Comfort defining requirements for a 0-to-1 product (like MEM) with evolving scope, including working with design on portal/UI workflows
  • Ability to break down ambiguous roadmap items and solution briefs into scoped, sequenced, engineering-ready PRDs
  • Familiarity with mobile-specific considerations (app store release processes, platform guidelines, mobile UX patterns) is a plus
  • Fluent with - or genuinely eager to learn - AI-assisted product workflows (e.g., using AI tools to accelerate PRD drafting, backlog refinement, research synthesis, and documentation) in order to move quickly in a fast-paced environment
  • 2-5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Manager, Product Owner, or similar role, including at least 2 years working as an Agile Product Owner
  • Highly motivated self-starter with a desire to help others, take action, and seek out resources to excel within the role
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into non-technical terms and vice versa
  • Ability to work independently as a contributing member of a high-paced, focused team, managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to work under pressure
  • Ability to socialize ideas and influence decisions without direct authority
  • Collaborative by nature, with a strong desire to dig in and learn independently and through asking questions
  • Comfortable partnering with and reporting to leadership based in the U.S., with strong cross-time-zone communication habits
  • Working knowledge of product and sprint backlog tracking, burn-down metrics, velocity, and work breakdown techniques
  • Solid understanding of Agile software development processes and principles
  • Bachelor s degree in business, computer science, or equivalent work experience
Preferred Skills:
  • Domain experience in Convenience Retail, ERP, Logistics, or Financial transaction processing solutions
Behavioral Competencies:
  • Ensures Accountability
  • Manages Complexity
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Balances Stakeholders
  • Collaborates Effectively

This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.

title: Network Engineer II
jobDescription:
Position Summary... As part of the Network Team the primary responsibility is to ensure that the network health which includes wired and wireless connectivity, for Walmart US stores, clubs, and distribution centres is good at any given point of time for customers and associates to communicate and operate without any hiccups hindering customer or associate experience.
What youll do...
About the Team - NOC (Network Operations Center)

The Network Operations Center (NOC) team is responsible for the health and availability of the network infrastructure powering Walmart US Stores, Sams Club locations, and Distribution Centers. Our team consists of 10 members operating across a follow-the-sun model spanning the US and India, ensuring round-the-clock coverage and rapid response regardless of time zone.

At any given moment, the NOC team is the frontline safeguard ensuring that store, club, and distribution center networks remain operational - enabling associates and customers to communicate, transact, and operate without disruption. A network hiccup isnt just a technical event; its a potential barrier to a customers shopping experience or an associates ability to serve them, and our team exists to prevent and resolve that impact as quickly as possible.

What youll do:

-Identify and Troubleshoot network incidents prioritizing it based on the impact to Walmart associates and customers.
- Understand how to use monitoring tools which can help detect issues proactively and work toward a faster resolution
- Work with the urgency assigned to mitigate the issue within the SLA defined.
- Coordinate with counterpart teams to understand the details pertaining the issue and assist with resolution.
- Understand the need of the store and club business partners and work with them in tandem.
- Be crystal clear in written and oral communications. Work with US engineers and partners and handover status to US shift when India shift is over.
- Leverage the overall experience to gauge the situation and act swiftly as per the need of the hour
- Maintaining the network devices to be in compliance for efficient operation

What youll bring:

- Minimum 3-4 years of pure network engineering experience - having worked in a NOC environment or project implementation team.
- Good experience handling network hardware - routers, switches & access points.
- Good to have - Linux and Python/ AI automation knowledge in network space


NOC Skillsets
  • Networking background with Hands-on experience in Routing & Switching (CCNA/ JNCIA/CCNP).
    Strong understanding and experience working on routers, switches, APs on various platforms (Cisco, Juniper, Meraki). Such as Cisco 2900, 4K ISR, ENCS5412, Cisco 3650, 3850, 4500, 6500, 9300, Juniper EX2300, EX4600 and Meraki MS425, MS225.
  • Experience in routing protocols : RIP, EIGRP, OSPF, IS-IS and BGP
  • Strong troubleshooting skills on Juniper/Cisco and Meraki devices along with SDN knowledge.
  • Understanding and troubleshooting of Switching concepts like VLAN, VTP, STP, RSTP, Ether-Channels (PAGP & LACP) and Stacking.
  • Basic knowledge of Broadcast/ARP/MAC address
  • Wired & Wireless Networking knowledge
  • Should have hands on troubleshooting experience of VLAN
  • Should have implemented and troubleshooted HSRP
  • Hands on experience on MPLS protocol.
  • Experience in IPSEC & DMVPN technology.
  • Troubleshooting knowledge in wireless : CAPWAP, LWAPP protocols ,Cisco AP s, Mist APs, MR46 Meraki APs and Wireless controllers.
  • Usage of ticketing and troubleshooting tools like Service now and Wireshark respectively
  • WLAN IEEE802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax Test experience
  • Performance WLAN tests (preferable)
  • Knowledge in Nexus, automation and SDWAN technologies is an added advantage
  • Scripting Knowledge of Automation Scripts - Python / Perl / TCL - added advantage
  • Independent Project handling with analytical ability



 Wireless ( Store & DC ):
  • Maintaining the functionality of the stores/Clubs wireless connectivity and entirety of the network at all of our distribution centres.
  • Troubleshooting general wireless slowness at stores and clubs/DC s.
  • Working a wide variety of wireless escalations through outlook and Service now.
  • Working on all self-service incidents that are created by stores associates that relate to any potential wireless issues they are experiencing.
  • Take calls from both associates and venders over a variety of wireless issues and push them to resolution.
  • Working with store associates to power cycle any of the wireless hardware infrastructure if needed.
  • Communicating with third party vendors to ensure that they have everything working on their equipment and for any equipment that needs to be replaced.
  • We will also ensure that they are doing their part by getting hourly updates from them for any issues they have with their equipment
  • Perform wired troubleshooting that could potentially affect wireless devices.
  • Ensuring the switches power supply is giving enough POE to power on all of the access points.
  • Checking DHCP Snooping on all switches and interfaces.
  • Checking for DHCP/DNS errors in the ISP and ensuring that the wireless devices are receiving IP addresses.
  • Performing in depth troubleshooting with members of management by having them recreate the issue while we track the device and pinpoint what exactly they are having issues with.
  • Communicating with store associates for validation that they themselves and customers are able to use their personal and corporate devices without any issues or slowness.
  • Validating the meshed AP in the yard of a DC are set up correctly.
  • Work with the systems team at DCs to notify them of any Access points that are offline. Monitoring the store wireless environment and logistics environment.
  • Monitor auto-generated tickets for down Access points and down Internet VRFs.
  • Working with Wireless controllers - Cisco (HREAP), MIST.
  • Working with the wireless engineering team on certain changes to the environment.


Wired (Store & DC ):
  • Troubleshooting packet loss, overutilization, and down circuits
  • Troubleshoot any and all routing issues at store & DC level.
  • Troubleshoot voice issues, from a single extension to all the voice at site. This includes static, one-way dialling, paging, stuck calls; and down voice gateways, and voice cards on routers.
  • Troubleshoot end devices that are not receiving an IP address, not connecting, or are experiencing slowness.
  • Work with third party vendors on incidents to troubleshoot and/or replace connections, cabling, and hardware.
  • Working with L3 and Cisco on any TAC cases for the store wired/ voice environment.
  • Working with sites to T/S down equipment before dispatching cabling and or replacements.
  • Assisting Field Support on Down systems and Down Power situations.
  • Monitoring overall ticket queues and making sure to maintain all tickets so that they do not go outside their SLA.
  • Assisting Field Project Supervisors and Store Planners with port configurations whenever the tool fails them..
  • Working with sites to troubleshoot and resolve spanning-tree issues.
  • Troubleshooting impacting DC voice issues.

title: Senior Staff Engineer, Kubernetes Platform & Networking
jobDescription:
Who are we

Equinix is the worlds digital infrastructure company, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriersbecause progress starts with fresh ideas. Youll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes youbecause when you feel valued, youre empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to join the Reliability Engineering team that operates a bare-metal Kubernetes platform across multiple metro locations. The platform''s architecture is defined and the build is underway, you will help deploy, operate and continuously improve it, from OS provisioning on racked servers through a multi-cluster fleet managed from a central management plane, with a software-defined data plane deployed via GitOps.

This is a deliberately broad role. We are not looking for someone who owns a layer and hands everything below it across a boundary. You will work alongside the teams that own the physical hardware, the underlay network, and the data plane software, and you need enough fluency in all three to reason about a fault before escalating it. Where you find the design falls short in practice, we expect you to say so and to shape how it evolves.

You will join the Digital Interconnection Engineering organization. The team owns the full application stack for interconnection and the Kubernetes platform for the software-defined data plane across multiple metros. We operate with an automation-first, GitOps-driven culture and a strong commitment to operational rigor, documented runbooks, and blameless postmortems.

Responsibilities

OS Provisioning Bare-Metal Infrastructure

  • Own OS installation (Debian/Ubuntu) across bare-metal servers in multiple metros using PXE/iPXE imaging and cloud-init, and harden the OS prior to cluster bootstrap

  • Build and maintain a repeatable, zero-touch provisioning pipeline so every metro is deployed consistently without manual per-node intervention

  • Partner with the teams that own the hardware on BIOS/firmware baselines, high-speed NIC configuration and disk layout standards (separate NVMe for etcd, SSD for OS) and be able to diagnose faults at that layer, not just report them

Kubernetes Control Plane Worker Nodes

  • Deploy and operate Kubernetes clusters across all metros with quorum-based control-plane fault tolerance and correct failure-domain placement across racks, PDUs, or availability zones

  • Maintain the Layer 4 load balancer or keepalived VIP fronting all kube-apiserver instances, so no client depends on a single node

  • Manage worker node provisioning, CNI configuration, and end-to-end cluster validation before workloads are onboarded

CI/CD Data Plane Deployment

  • Build and own the CI/CD pipeline that deploys the software-defined data plane, including automated throughput and latency validation gates that must pass before promotion to production. The data plane software itself is configured and troubleshot by the team that owns it, your ownership is the pipeline and the gates

  • Own data-plane observability: monitoring, alerting thresholds, and operational runbooks

Network

  • Operate on top of a multi-metro underlay and partner with network and security teams on VLANs, BGP peering, NIC bonding, private connectivity, firewall rules and segmentation

  • Validate connectivity end to end across environments, and troubleshoot far enough into the network layer to isolate a problem before handing it over

OS Kubernetes Upgrades

  • Plan and execute rolling OS and Kubernetes upgrades across the fleet with zero unplanned downtime; maintain tested upgrade runbooks and validated etcd snapshot/restore procedures before every major change

  • Own the etcd snapshot schedule, retention policy, and offsite storage; verify restore runbooks before each site goes live

  • Apply the platform''s patching cadence across the fleet, tracking CVEs affecting the OS, Kubernetes and cluster components

Management Plane

  • Administer the centralized management plane across all clusters, including RBAC, cluster registration and policy enforcement, and keep production and non-production management planes strictly isolated to prevent blast-radius cascades from configuration changes

  • Drive GitOps-based fleet configuration management to keep clusters consistent, auditable, and drift-free

On-Call Incident Management

  • Own your shift of a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, and lead incident response for control-plane, data-plane, and network events

  • Drive blameless postmortems and systematically eliminate recurring failure modes through automation, better runbooks, and sharper alerting

  • Contribute to the shared incident-command process, and maintain the runbooks for the systems you operate

What Success Looks Like, First 9-12 Months

  • Provisioning is fully automated and repeatable, new nodes and metros brought up with no manual per-node steps

  • Deployment pipeline in production, with throughput and latency gates enforced before promotion

  • Management plane administered across all clusters; production and non-production planes isolated; GitOps driving cluster configuration

  • OS and Kubernetes upgrades executed on cadence across the fleet with documented, tested runbooks

  • etcd snapshot and restore tested and signed off before each site goes live

  • Observability and alerting in place for the systems you operate, including the data plane

  • Recurring failure modes measurably reduced through automation and runbook improvements

Qualifications

Required

  • OS bare metal: Deep hands-on Linux/Ubuntu provisioning at scale, PXE/iPXE imaging, cloud-init, BIOS/firmware management, OS hardening

  • Hardware fluency: Comfortable with BMC/IPMI, SMART data and platform sensors; able to diagnose disk, memory, NIC and power faults and work with vendors through warranty replacement

  • Kubernetes: Strong experience deploying and operating RKE2 or kubeadm clusters on bare metal, etcd operations, kube-apiserver HA, CNI (Multus/SR-IOV), multi-cluster fleet management

  • Rancher or equivalent management plane: Production experience managing multiple clusters through Rancher Prime, Rancher, or comparable fleet tooling

  • CI/CD for infrastructure: GitOps or pipeline-driven infrastructure deployment, Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, or Fleet

  • Networking: Hands-on with VLANs, BGP, bonded NICs, SR-IOV and private connectivity, with enough depth to troubleshoot across the boundary rather than only consume it

  • Upgrades: Demonstrated zero-downtime rolling upgrades of both OS and Kubernetes across a multi-node fleet

  • Operational rigor: Experience running platforms where availability is measured in minutes of downtime per year, and where an unreviewed change is the most likely cause of an outage

  • On-call: Comfortable owning an on-call shift and leading infrastructure incident response

  • Automation mindset: Everything-as-code, repeatable and auditable; strong bias toward automation over manual operations

Preferred

  • Familiarity with 6WIND VSR or other DPDK-based data planes, enough to build and validate a deployment and performance-testing pipeline around one

  • SR-IOV NIC tuning and data-plane performance validation

  • SDN or private-connectivity platforms (Equinix Fabric, VyOS, or equivalent)

  • Familiarity with LLM provider APIs and AI/agent gateway proxying patterns, since inference traffic from multiple providers transits this platform

  • Experience operating infrastructure across geographically distributed sites

Job Title: Snowflake Developer (Data Lake Program with Snowflake Cortex)
Role Overview
The Snowflake Developer is responsible for building and optimizing data pipelines and analytical datasets within a Snowflake-based data lakehouse. This role also includes leveraging Snowflake Cortex to enable AI-driven data transformations, natural language processing, and intelligent data applications directly within the data platform.
Key Responsibilities
1. Data Ingestion Integration
  • Develop and maintain scalable data ingestion pipelines (batch and near real-time).
  • Load data from databases, APIs, files, and streaming systems into Snowflake.
  • Handle structured and semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet, Avro, CSV).
  • Integrate Snowflake with cloud storage platforms (S3, Azure Data Lake, GCS).
2. Data Transformation (ELT)
  • Build ELT pipelines using Snowflake SQL and native features (Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables).
  • Implement transformations across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers.
  • Use tools like dbt for modular, reusable, and testable transformations.
3. Snowflake Cortex AI Enablement
  • Leverage Snowflake Cortex functions within SQL for AI-powered transformations.
  • Implement use cases such as:
    • Text summarization of large datasets (logs, documents)
    • Sentiment analysis and classification
    • Natural language enrichment of datasets
  • Work with vector embeddings and similarity search for semantic use cases.
  • Assist in building AI-ready datasets for downstream analytics and ML.
  • Collaborate with data scientists to integrate AI/ML logic into Snowflake pipelines.
  • Support simple prompt engineering within Cortex functions for optimized outputs.
4. Data Modeling
  • Design and implement analytical data models (star schema, snowflake schema).
  • Build fact and dimension tables optimized for BI and AI use cases.
  • Ensure datasets are structured for both analytics and AI consumption.
5. Performance Cost Optimization
  • Optimize SQL queries and Snowflake workloads.
  • Use clustering, caching, and efficient compute strategies.
  • Monitor warehouse usage and control costs, including Cortex consumption.
6. Data Quality Validation
  • Implement data validation checks and quality frameworks.
  • Ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data.
  • Debug and resolve pipeline and data issues.
7. Security Governance
  • Apply RBAC, masking policies, and row-level security.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance and privacy standards.
  • Maintain proper documentation and lineage for datasets.
8. Collaboration Agile Delivery
  • Work with architects, analysts, and AI/ML teams.
  • Translate business and AI use cases into technical implementations.
  • Participate in Agile development processes.

title: Engineer II, Occupational Safety
jobDescription:
Position Summary
The Engineer 2, Occupational Safety is responsible for supporting and implementing occupational health and safety programs across plant operations. Working under general supervision, the incumbent applies established safety engineering principles, technical standards, and regulatory requirements to identify, evaluate, and mitigate workplace hazards. The role provides operational safety support across all shifts, ensures compliance with statutory and company safety requirements, and contributes to a proactive safety culture through risk management, incident prevention, emergency preparedness, and continuous improvement initiatives.
The position supports the organization''s Safety Operating System (SOS) and collaborates closely with Production, Maintenance, Security, Contractors, and Safety Workmen to ensure a safe and compliant work environment.


A. Shift Safety Management
  • Ensure comprehensive safety coverage across all shifts (General/A/B/C) by deploying and supervising Safety Workmen in critical and high-risk operational areas.
  • Conduct shift handover briefings covering ongoing safety concerns, permit status, hot work activities, incidents, and unresolved safety observations.
  • Perform routine shop-floor safety inspections and patrols at defined intervals and document findings.
  • Monitor and enforce compliance with Permit-to-Work (PTW) requirements for:
    • Hot Work
    • Confined Space Entry
    • Work at Height
    • Electrical Isolation (LOTO)
    • Excavation Activities
  • Identify unsafe conditions and initiate immediate corrective actions.


B. Safety Workmen Supervision
  • Allocate Safety Workmen based on operational risk assessments, manpower availability, and critical work activities.
  • Monitor attendance, effectiveness, PPE compliance, and performance of Safety Workmen throughout the shift.
  • Provide guidance and training on:
    • Fire watch duties
    • Gas testing procedures
    • Barricading and access control
    • Emergency response protocols
  • Review shift reports submitted by Safety Workmen and escalate critical observations promptly.
  • Deliver on-the-job coaching and periodic refresher training to strengthen safety competencies.


C. Incident and Emergency Management
  • Serve as the first responder and safety coordinator during accidents, near misses, fires, medical emergencies, or other critical events.
  • Ensure timely emergency response actions, including:
    • First aid coordination
    • Evacuation management
    • Firefighting response
    • Emergency communication
  • Lead preliminary incident investigations and root cause analysis.
  • Document incidents and recommend corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Support implementation and verification of incident closure actions.


D. Compliance and Safety Documentation
  • Ensure compliance with:
    • Factories Act and applicable State Factory Rules
    • Indian statutory EHS regulations
    • ISO 45001 requirements
    • Internal company safety standards and procedures
  • Maintain and update:
    • PTW records
    • Safety logbooks
    • Gas testing reports
    • Incident registers
    • Compliance documentation
  • Verify that all contractors and new employees have completed required safety inductions before entering operational areas.
  • Exercise stop-work authority when unsafe conditions or behaviors are observed.
  • Issue safety observations, violation notices, and corrective actions as required by company procedures.
  • Support planning, coordination, and execution of emergency drills including fire, evacuation, and medical response simulations.
  • Conduct periodic inspections of emergency and safety equipment, including:
    • Fire extinguishers
    • First aid kits
    • Eye wash stations
    • Emergency response equipment


E. Hazard Identification and Risk Control
  • Monitor and drive adherence to 5S and workplace housekeeping standards.
  • Ensure fire exits, emergency routes, assembly points, and safety signage remain unobstructed and compliant.
  • Verify proper storage, handling, transportation, and labeling of hazardous materials and chemicals.
  • Conduct hazard identification exercises and workplace risk assessments.
  • Develop, implement, and track corrective and preventive actions to eliminate identified risks.


F. Coordination and Reporting
  • Coordinate with Production, Maintenance, Engineering, Utilities, Security, and Contractors to ensure safe execution of all plant activities.
  • Prepare and submit daily and shift-end safety reports, metrics, and MIS updates.
  • Participate in daily safety reviews, toolbox talks, and operational meetings.
  • Escalate safety concerns, manpower shortages, equipment failures, and compliance risks to Safety Management in a timely manner.
  • Support safety improvement projects and contribute toward departmental safety objectives and milestones.


Educational Qualification
Mandatory
  • Bachelor''s Degree in Mechanical Engineering.
  • Master''s Degree (M.Tech.) in Industrial Safety Engineering.
Preferred
  • Additional certifications in Occupational Health Safety, Fire Safety, Risk Assessment, ISO 45001, or related EHS disciplines.


Professional Experience
Required
  • 5 to 6 years of hands-on Occupational Safety experience in manufacturing, automotive, heavy engineering, process, or industrial environments.
  • Proven field-based safety management experience involving shop-floor operations, hazard identification, risk assessment, incident investigation, emergency response, and statutory compliance.
  • Experience managing high-risk activities including Permit-to-Work (PTW), LOTO, confined space entry, work at height, hot work, and contractor safety management.
  • Experience supervising Safety Workmen, safety inspections, audits, and shift-based safety operations.
Preferred
  • Prior experience in the automotive manufacturing industry.
  • Exposure to large-scale industrial facilities with automated manufacturing systems, machinery safety, and fire protection systems.


Technical Knowledge Competencies
  • Strong knowledge of occupational safety regulations, Factories Act, applicable State Factory Rules, BIS/IS standards, and ISO 45001 requirements.
  • Proficiency in Machine Safety Risk Assessments, hazard identification, risk evaluation, and risk mitigation in accordance with ISO 12100 and related machinery safety standards.
  • Sound understanding of Fire Protection Engineering, including fire detection systems, fire suppression systems, fire load assessment, and emergency preparedness.
  • Working knowledge of International Building Code (IBC) and other applicable national and international safety standards.
  • Experience in implementing statutory, regulatory, and corporate EHS requirements across industrial operations.
  • Strong understanding of Safety Analytics and AI/ML applications for hazard detection, risk prediction, incident trend analysis, and safety performance monitoring.
  • Ability to develop, validate, interpret, and communicate AI-driven safety models and risk-based recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in safety reporting, root cause analysis, CAPA implementation, and safety management systems.
